decision: Keep existing default role; no measured advantage and inadequate sample for a general benefit claim.
limitations: Four original synthetic cases, one trial per arm; not representative of broad design-production quality.
Both arms and both independent judges used the same model family; shared bias remains possible.
Every scored criterion passed: ceiling effect, no observed advantage; production defaults remain unchanged.
Eight earlier trials blocked due to an omitted input filename; all are retained separately, not discarded from study history.
The corrected wave reuses the same fixtures after infrastructure repair; judges are arm-blinded, but this is not an unseen confirmation after tuning.
Native token usage and cost were unavailable; no cost-efficiency claim.
Record checker validates hashes and arithmetic, not semantic grading or human approval.
record_serializer_correction: Initial checker configuration used an object model field and omitted explicit settings/budget/hash map. The checker rejected it; v2 conforms to the documented schema. Raw trials, inputs, score locks and verdicts were not changed.
raw_evidence: Private retained task evidence under .mirket/implementation/harness-completion-2026-10-20; never included in package publication.
